summary: Mathematical obstruction verified: for every m, C_m={sum_{i<m} ε_i 3^i | ε_i∈{0,1}} is an m-dimensional unique-subset-sum cube with no nonconstant 3-term AP. In x+z=2y, reduction mod 3 forces the least ternary digits of x,y,z equal; induction after subtracting/dividing by 3 forces x=y=z. Thus arbitrary cube dimension from recurrence cannot imply even a 3AP. C_m is sparse (density (2/3)^m), so it does not contradict Szemerédi; an additional positive-density/alignment input remains necessary.
